messages:
Maya Iyer: Heads up — I'm seeing a spike in billed tokens for a couple enterprise accounts yesterday that doesn't match request logs. Can someone triage?
Liam Chen: which accounts? quick grep?
Maya Iyer: NovaCore and Brightwave. Invoice ids 2025-11-19-NOVAC and 2025-11-19-BW. Billing shows ~30-40% more tokens than server logs for the 03:10-03:20 UTC window.
Priya Rao: did we deploy the SDK/proxy change on Nov 19? there was an embedding batching rename that could cause duplicate keys to be emitted.
Liam Chen: we deployed sdk-proxy v1.9.3 at 03:11:50 UTC. That build accidentally emitted both `tokens` and `token_count` for ~3 minutes due to a rollback race.
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice 2025-11-19-NOVAC created (total_tokens=2,010,400, billable_tokens=2,010,400)
Alex Gomez: if billing ingests all metric keys naively it may have summed both names. we need to verify whether the billing pipeline dedupes keys.
Priya Rao: can we query metrics to confirm overlap and quantify the duplicate window? I can run a query if you give me exact metric names and time range.
Liam Chen: window is 03:11:50 - 03:14:40 UTC. both `tokens` and `token_count` emitted. I'll run ES and extract per-route counts.
Maya Iyer: Finance needs delta per invoice (billed vs true). Also need dollar conversion for credits. Priya — can you estimate $ per 1k tokens per enterprise tier?
Priya Rao: NovaCore is enterprise tier A: $0.0009/1k for generation, $0.0011/1k for embeddings. Brightwave is tier B. I'll compute exact mix once Liam provides route-level counts.
Liam Chen: ES query used (metrics-prod):
```
GET /metrics/_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "filter": [
        {"terms": {"metric": ["tokens", "token_count"]}},
        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "2025-11-19T03:10:00Z", "lte": "2025-11-19T03:20:00Z"}}}
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
Maya Iyer: Please paste the CSV output in #finance when ready. We'll need it as evidence for customer credits.
Liam Chen: uploaded CSV to /shared/finance/token-audit/1769250001-novac-bw-audit.csv with columns customer, route, billed_tokens, actual_tokens, delta_tokens.
Alex Gomez: I'll patch billing-parser to prefer canonical metric names and ignore duplicates. also add a unit test.
Priya Rao: quick calc from Liam's numbers: NovaCore delta = 412,500 tokens -> mix ~95% generation -> approx 412.5k/1000 * $0.0009 = $371.25. Brightwave delta = 152,300 tokens -> approx $121.8. both < $500 so no VP sign-off needed.
Maya Iyer: good. Action items: (1) Liam produce per-customer, per-route true vs billed CSV (done). (2) Priya compute dollar deltas and draft credit memos (in progress). (3) Alex patch parser to de-duplicate and add feature flag for stricter validation. (4) Finance to hold those invoices pending corrected run.
billing-bot: [automated] billing-runner job 2025-11-19-03:30 completed with warnings: duplicate_metric_keys detected
Liam Chen: I'll run a dry-run backfill re-calculating billables for Nov 19 with idempotency token. won't apply until Finance approves.
Alex Gomez: adding a quick pre-bill check that fails if delta >5% between raw intake and billing-aggregator; will be behind a feature flag to avoid broad impact.
Maya Iyer: please include dry-run results in the CSV. Priya, draft customer-facing note referencing "metric rename bug caused transient duplicate emission; we have issued a billing adjustment".
Priya Rao: drafting now and attaching the credit memo template. I'll copy the token -> dollar math and include a small apology.
Liam Chen: dry-run output: NovaCore corrected billable_tokens = billed_tokens - 412500 = 1,598,900; Brightwave corrected = billed_tokens - 152300 = 1,223,700. Dropping final CSV to shared folder.
Maya Iyer: finance: approve automated credits for these two customers (both under $500). Schedule corrected invoices for next billing cycle and send credit memos.
Maya Iyer: closing once backfill applied and support templates sent. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
